game.name: Race Driver : GRID (Japan)
game.desc: Race Driver Grid on Xbox 360 puts your driving skills to the test in three different driving environments. Alternate between America and its muscle cars, Europe and its legendary models and Japan and its drifts, all in well-known cities that have been fully modelled. Beware, however, of collisions which can prove fatal. A multiplayer mode allows several players to compete online.
